operations.details: Verified current HMLR title-plan guidance updated July 2026.
Title-plan general extent separated from exact legal boundary.
Registration-era OS mapping version retained as plan context only.
Title-plan edging rejected as parcel elevation evidence.
Determined-boundary application requires supporting evidence and surveyor plan.
General and determined boundary states kept distinct.
Boundary determination not promoted to DTM or vertical-datum evidence.
Both HMLR URLs confirmed absent from prior source registry.
No plan line or application state substituted for terrain measurement.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
